q.q: Six persons Ali, Asad, Hina, Mariam, Salman, Waqar sit around a circular table, all facing the centre. Hina is not an immediate neighbour of Waqar. Hina sits immediately to the right of Asad. Mariam sits immediately to the left of Ali. Asad sits exactly opposite Ali. Hina sits second to the right of Waqar. Who sits second to the left of Mariam?
q.e: Fix one person, then place the others using 'immediate', 'opposite' and 'second to' clues; left and right are taken from the seated person's own view (facing the centre).

q.q: Statements: All cups are books. Some books are tables. All tables are chairs. Conclusions: I. All books are tables.  II. All cups are chairs.  III. Some tables are books.  IV. Some chairs are cups. Which of the conclusions definitely follow(s)?
o: Only I, II and III follow
q.e: Draw all possible Venn diagrams for the three statements; a conclusion follows only if it holds in every one of them.
